author: Greko19
quote: GTA VI is GTA V, but worse. The formula has barely changed. You could even argue that it’s more **** V DLC than a truly new game.Paying $100 for a game that can’t even maintain 30 FPS on current-generation consoles is disappointing, to say the least. It’s equally disappointing that the game is only available digitally, and that professional critics have failed to properly criticize any of these issues while still awarding it perfect 10/10 **** game is good, but it doesn’t revolutionize anything. Not even close.
